name: Curse
source:
Your university female friend is behaving strange. You and your female buddy, both psychology students, set out to find what's happening.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160404053637/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-a.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
你的一名大学女同学近来举止古怪。你与另一位女性好友都是心理学系学生，两人决定一同查明她身上究竟发生了什么。

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160404053637/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-a.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
